title: WS9 row S09 (freeform patch) vs our llm-proxy — RECON gate-state row (record-only, never fails; the row reports RECON). State of record: the R0 freeform apply_patch ENGINE is ported (parity §2.2: apply.rs/parser.rs/seek_sequence.rs shared; the codex ApplyPatchTool is registered in the tool registry), but the freeform surface is NOT DECLARED on the grok-build seat the redteam lane drives (the ACP/headless toolset advertises search_replace; the codex toolset rides the Codex builtin agent) — W6-2 (PROP-W6-2 FREEFORM-APPLY-PATCH) is MINOR-OWED, activation-gated on the B3 Astra-row operator ruling (feature-ladder R12; mechanism bead splittable from activation per parity §3). This case records the GATE STATE, not a delta: one bounded qwen turn; (1) the ndjson tools_present pin records whether apply_patch is advertised in the available tool list, (2) the wire recon records whether the apply_patch tool schema is present in the request tools[] array (the wire-level advertisement — the discriminating surface). Verdict semantics: RECON + UNPROVEN (activation gate PROP-W6-2/B3) while the records show 0 advertisements — marked, not guessed: no freeform patch can be issued on this seat, so no patch-fidelity claim is made; when the records show apply_patch ADVERTISED (W6-2 activation landed between recon and Phase-B launch), this row flips to PROVEN-instrument and the scored follow-up (a tool-call case with a real patch round-trip + the grammar-surface pins) is filed as a separate additive case — promotion is a coordinator ruling, never silent. No severity applies to a gate-state row (severity attaches to observed deltas once the surface is live).
